exceptions.reason: The row documents a native attribute that the React part does not read. In Vase UI the attribute goes to the element through the attributes, with its type from `HTMLAttributes`. A declared prop would take it out of the attributes.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the root for `aria-labelledby`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the label, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
